insurer: Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Limited
sumInsured: Base Sum Insured options: 2 Lacs, 3 Lacs, 4 Lacs, 5 Lacs, 7 Lacs, 10 Lacs, 15 Lacs, 20 Lacs, 25 Lacs, 50 Lacs, 75 Lacs, 1 Crore, 2 Crores, 3 Crores, 4 Crores, 5 Crores, 6 Crores

great.name: Room Rent
great.quote: Room Rent: Actuals up to Sum Insured
great.reference: Annexure III - Product Benefit Table (Activ One NXT)
great.explanation: Room rent is covered at actuals up to the Sum Insured with no daily cap mentioned. This reduces the risk of room-rent linked deductions and gives flexibility to choose a room.

great.name: Restore Benefit
great.quote: Super Reload: 2X - Day 1; 2nd Claim Onwards - Unlimited Times (upto Base Sum Insured)
great.reference: Annexure III - Product Benefit Table (Activ One NXT); Section C.8 Super Reload
great.explanation: A Super Reload is available from Day 1, with unlimited reloads from the 2nd claim onwards, each reload up to the Base Sum Insured. This can significantly increase available cover in the same policy year after the base Sum Insured is used.

great.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
great.quote: The Company shall indemnify the Pre-Hospitalization Medical Expenses... for up to 90 days immediately prior to the date of such Hospitalization.
great.explanation: Pre-hospitalization medical expenses are covered for up to 90 days before admission. This helps pay for diagnostics and consultations leading up to hospitalization.

great.name: Modern Treatments
great.quote: Modern Procedures / Treatments: Actuals up to Sum Insured for listed procedures
great.reference: Annexure III - Product Benefit Table; Section C.1.1.1(e) indicative list
great.explanation: Listed modern procedures/treatments are covered at actuals up to the Sum Insured. This avoids restrictive sub-limits for many advanced treatments.

great.name: NCB
great.quote: Super Credit (increases irrespective of claim): 100% of Base Sum Insured per year, up to 500% of Base Sum Insured (up to Max of 3 Cr under this benefit)
great.reference: Annexure III - Product Benefit Table; Section C.10.8 Super Credit
great.explanation: Sum Insured increases by 100% of Base Sum Insured each year irrespective of claims, up to 500% (max 3 Cr under this benefit). This is stronger than typical no-claim bonuses that reduce or reset after a claim.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: D.1.3 30-day Waiting Period (Code-Excl03) ... Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.explanation: Illness-related claims are not covered for the first 30 days from the first policy start date, except for accidents. This is a standard waiting period in retail health insurance.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries / treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage
good.reference: Section D.1.2 Specified disease / procedure Waiting Period (Code-Excl02)
good.explanation: Specified diseases/procedures are covered only after 24 months of continuous coverage. This is broadly in line with market norms for listed conditions.

good.name: Domiciliary Hospitalization
good.quote: The Company shall indemnify the Medical Expenses incurred during the Policy Period on Domiciliary Hospitalization...
good.explanation: Medical expenses for domiciliary hospitalization (treatment at home when hospitalization is required) are covered as per policy conditions. This can help when hospital admission is not possible or advisable.

good.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: for up to 180 days from the date of discharge from the Hospital.
good.explanation: Post-hospitalization medical expenses are covered for up to 180 days after discharge. This is a standard duration and helps cover follow-up treatment and medicines.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED)... shall be excluded until the expiry of years / months as specified in the Policy Schedule / Product Benefit Table
good.reference: Section D.1.1 Pre-Existing Diseases (PED) (Code-Excl01); Annexure III (shows 'Pre-Existing Diseases Waiting Period: 3 Years')
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are covered only after the waiting period shown in the Policy Schedule/Product Benefit Table, and the table indicates 3 years. This means PED-related claims may be rejected until you complete that waiting period.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: items in List I, II, III & IV will be excluded unless forms a part of In-patient hospitalization.
bad.reference: Section D.2.5 Non-Medical Expenses; Annexure I
bad.explanation: Many non-medical/consumable items listed in Annexure I are excluded. This can create out-of-pocket costs for common hospital supplies even during a claim.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: Preferred Provider Network (PPN) Discount... then the Policyholder / Insured Person shall bear a Co-Payment of 10% on each and every claim arising in such regard.
bad.reference: Section C.10.5 Preferred Provider Network (PPN) Discount
bad.explanation: A 10% co-payment applies on each and every claim in the stated PPN Discount scenario. This means you may have to pay part of every claim from your pocket in addition to any non-payable items.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
